description: Runs the H3 context-IR enhancer over each candidate idea so their structure can be compared.

variables.opening_idea: Task: Ref2VA. Duration: 5.17 seconds. Continuity: standalone. Idea: this marmot croons the slow jazz song in a smokey club. <Picture 1> is a subject and setting reference: it establishes who the marmot (S1) is - its fur, face, build and the microphone it sings into - and what the club looks like, its stage dressing, haze and warm palette. Its retention is partially_copy: it carries identity, wardrobe, set and palette, and because this is the first clip of the performance the opening framing is its own. <Audio 1> is the recording of the song and its retention is partially_copy: it is reproduced as the video's own soundtrack, and the marmot (S1) sings it at the microphone with its mouth, jaw, throat and body moving in synchronisation with the recording, phrasing with the melody and pausing only where the singing pauses. Write this as one continuous static-to-slow-drifting shot with no cut in it, the opening stretch of a much longer performance: the song is already underway at the first frame, it neither introduces the song nor resolves it, and it ends mid-phrase with the marmot still singing. The soundscape is the room itself: a close, smoky club with a low crowd murmur, the faint hum of the stage amplifiers and the occasional clink of a glass under the singing, all at a steady level from the first frame to the last. There is no non-diegetic music - the song is the performance itself, sung into the microphone on stage, so nothing is scored underneath it and no tempo, key or arrangement changes are introduced that the recording does not already have.
